episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: As they continue on their world-saving adventure, Fighter, Paladin, Mage, and Dark Elf decide to upgrade their armors to the latest version after a difficult battle in a dungeon. But what is the difference between bikini armor, and a normal bikini?

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: The four heroes are summoned to an audience with the king. The world is in peril, and his royal highness orders them to go on a journey to save it. Fighter asks him for the money they need to help them prepare, but the king is a cheapskate.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: The Special Hero Dispensation Act gives heroes the right to legally take items from treasure chests and dressers in town. When the four adventurers run out of money and can't continue their journey, they use this law to start invading the townspeople's houses, but they get a bit too greedy.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: The heroes need a key to get through a cave and continue with their adventure. But the arrogant mayor of the town has it, and he won't hand it over unless they complete the tasks he gives them. Fighter decides that this must be a trial for the heroes, and ends up doing the mayor's chores.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: Women, and only women, are being attacked in a nearby forest. The heroes go to try and find whoever's responsible.
